known.title: Delta-round eligibility does not require that the previous round completed, so after a blocked lens an empty delta can leave unchanged code unreviewed
known.locator: Research, Decisions, decision 2 (line 67); Steps, row 3 code_review_rounds (line 91)
known.summary: delta-round eligibility does not require that the previous round completed: when a lens returns blocked on unreadable input, fixing that input leaves an empty delta eligible, so unchanged code never gets reviewed; delta rounds must follow only a round in which every required lens completed against its recorded head

protected.summary: Request correction: the user asked for fewer review rounds. Code review gets lens rounds and delta rounds; plan review does not change (no plan lenses and no plan delta round), because the plan-review benchmark showed no gain worth its cost.

Yolo decision: a full code-review round dispatches three `code-reviewer` lens reviewers (`correctness`, `spec-and-tests`, `text-and-safety`) at once and posts their blocks in one comment, an idea that the user suggested. The plan records the evidence: more real defects than one reviewer, at about 2.1 times the tokens.
